ensembleNote: In the live system this detector signal sits alongside deterministic checks (pHash near-duplicate, EXIF-vs-delivery consistency, C2PA presence, exact-hash match) and a Gemini semantic-consistency signal. Every signal is review-routing only: there is no code path from any score to a cancelled or denied refund.
